check-up and hygiene appointment Saturday rules

results.heading: Saturday
results.text: Saturday appointments are for check-ups and hygiene visits only; longer treatments are scheduled on weekdays.

results.heading: Booking an appointment
results.text: New and existing patients can book by email or phone. Tell us what the visit is for (check-up, pain, hygiene, whitening) and two or three preferred days; reception confirms a time.

results.heading: Cancellation policy
results.text: Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge up to 24 hours before the appointment time. Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice, and missed appointments, are charged ₺500.

results.heading: Visit length
results.text: Check-ups and hygiene visits take 30 minutes. Fillings take 45–60 minutes. Whitening takes 90 minutes.

results.heading: First visit
results.text: A first visit takes about 30 minutes and includes a check-up and, if needed, a panoramic X-ray. Please bring your ID and any recent X-rays.

args.subject: Your check-up and hygiene appointment
args.body:
Dear Enes,

Thank you for getting in touch. We would be happy to see you during your stay in Istanbul.

I have requested a 30-minute check-up and hygiene visit on Monday 26 October at 10:00. This is pending confirmation from our reception team, and we will let you know once it is confirmed.

Two alternatives in the same week, if you would prefer them:
- Monday 26 October at 13:00
- Tuesday 27 October at 10:00

Check-up and hygiene visits take 30 minutes (booking#visit-length). Please also note that our Saturday appointments are reserved for check-ups and hygiene visits only (hours#saturday).

Kind regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception
